source.review: original-resolution pixel audit with room and grounds crops

zones.title: Campus entry and classroom
zones.description: Inspect the landscaped school entrance and the complete furnished general classroom.

zones.title: Library and computer office
zones.description: Explore the reading library, computer workstations, stair landing, and visible furnishings.

zones.title: Art studio and cycle court
zones.translation: 美术教室与自行车庭院
zones.description: Study the art studio materials and the clearly visible bicycle court beside it.

zones.title: Music rehearsal room
zones.description: Inspect the pianos, percussion, guitar, stands, chairs, and rehearsal furniture.

zones.title: Gymnasium and washrooms
zones.description: Explore the indoor sports equipment and the adjacent sinks and toilet cubicles.

zones.title: School infirmary
zones.description: Inspect the examination couch, privacy screen, storage, stool, and treatment furniture.

zones.title: Corridor and lockers
zones.description: Follow the tiled corridor past hooks, bench seating, doors, and the locker bank.

zones.title: Equipment storeroom
zones.description: Inspect the shelves, racks, containers, bags, ropes, hoops, and stored sports gear.

zones.title: Preparation and utility room
zones.description: Explore the sinks, work surfaces, storage, office equipment, and waste station.

zones.title: Southern school grounds
zones.description: Explore the promenade, planted borders, mature trees, path lights, and raised planters.
